l4_icans_grade_steroids.quote: treat ICANS immediately with dexamethasone 10 mg IV every 6 hours

l4_crs_management.quote: give a repeat tocilizumab 8 mg/kg IV for the CRS component; tocilizumab does not cross the blood-brain barrier and does not treat ICANS itself

l4_neutropenic_sepsis.quote: obtain blood cultures and start broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour (piperacillin-tazobactam or cefepime

l4_airway_icu_seizure.quote: increase levetiracetam to 750-1000 mg twice daily (renally adjusted), obtain an urgent EEG
l4_airway_icu_seizure.note: ICU setting, monitoring and seizure management covered; explicit airway/aspiration precautions and serial ICE checks not stated.

l4_ddx_cns_relapse.quote: I would also keep CNS lymphoma progression in mind given his high CNS-IPI

l4_ddx_infection_bleed.quote: CNS infection is a major concern, including HSV encephalitis

l4_ddx_metabolic_seizure.quote: Other considerations are nonconvulsive status epilepticus

l4_ct_then_mri.quote: obtain an emergent noncontrast CT head to exclude hemorrhage and edema, followed by MRI brain with contrast and MRV

l4_eeg_lp_safe.quote: Lumbar puncture only after imaging and neurosurgical clearance, and after platelets are at least 50,000-100,000/uL and INR is corrected

l4_glucose_steroids_diabetes.note: Generic glucose management mentioned, but no link to dexamethasone-induced hyperglycemia or insulin plan.

l4_mn_lp_unsafe.quote: defer lumbar puncture until imaging is reviewed and platelets/coagulation are corrected
